chunks: Your god is only God. There is no other god but He. His knowledge extends over everything.

key_terms.لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ: There is no god but He

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's knowledge and oneness in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Taa-Haa, this verse reinforces the core tenet of Tawhid by contrasting the singular, all-encompassing knowledge of Allah with the limited understanding of creation. It serves as a theological anchor for Shia exegesis, highlighting that divine omniscience is the basis for both prophetic authority and the ultimate justice of the Imamate.
